about.text: A small Maroilles-style cheese named after the commune of Manicamp, cited in accounts going back to the French Revolution. It disappeared in the 1950s, was rediscovered in 1999, and is made now by the Ferme de la Pâturelle at Quierzy (Aisne).

sources.text: The history, the rediscovery and the present-day producer, from the article.
